Title: Card costs and when/how pay it

Messages.Author: Sydnelson
Messages.Body:
My local playgroup always questioning about usage of Ankara Citadel then I create this topic.

Is need to have entire blood on vampire when I announce the action even if will only pay half by Ankara Citadel text?

Example: A Tremere with 1 blood can try to recruit a Procurer that cost 2 blood?

I think no since rulebook section 6.2 says you need fulfill all requirements (including costs) when announce the action.

Another example: A Tremere with 2 blood try to recruit a Procurer that cost 2 blood, in the middle of action they (hope I use new wording correct here) plays an inferior Alacritivy that cost 2 blood but spend only 1 blood in the end due Ankara effect makes the Tremere with 1 blood when action reaches to end. Then when the action it is success since when I declare the action I fulfill costs requirements and Ankara reduce its costs or action fizzle since I don`t have blood to pay for each before use Ankara effect?

This query also makes me think in another one...

When use Charisma or Therboldy Realty and many other cards that increase or reduce costs I also need to have all card cost when I play the card or I can use the effect of those cards before check the payment requirements? The text of Ankara says "you pays only half" and those cards says, "you pay one more/less" due that my doubt.

Example: Enkidu with 1 blood and Charisma can plays a Raptor that cost 2 blood?

Example: A player with 1 pool and a Therboldy Realty can plays a Protected Resources? (I know, in this case the player will self-oust but I use it only as an example)

Ankara Citadel, Turkey, The, Equipment, 2 blood
This equipment card represents a unique location and does not count as equipment while in play. The vampire with this location pays only half of the blood cost for any cards he or she plays (round down).

Therbold Realty
Master: unique location. Locations cost you 1 less blood or pool.

Charisma
Unique master. Put this card on a ready vampire. This vampire's recruit ally actions cost 1 less blood or pool (but never less than 0 blood or pool).

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body:
> Sydnelson wrote:
> Ankara Citadel, Turkey, The, Equipment, 2 blood
> This equipment card represents a unique location and does not count as equipment while in play. The vampire with this location pays only half of the blood cost for any cards he or she plays (round down).
>
That text is outdated. Ankara Citadel was errated to follow the same template as Therbold Realty and Charisma.

> Therbold Realty
> Master: unique location. Locations cost you 1 less blood or pool.
>
> Charisma
> Unique master. Put this card on a ready vampire. This vampire's recruit ally actions cost 1 less blood or pool (but never less than 0 blood or pool).
>
Emphasis mine. Those cards modify the cost of the affected cards, and that is valid for all situations where the cost is relevant, including being able to play the card, paying for it at resolution, and deciding whether effects like Cavalier trigger.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Sydnelson wrote:
> My local playgroup always questioning about usage of Ankara Citadel then I create this topic.
>
> Is need to have entire blood on vampire when I announce the action even if will only pay half by Ankara Citadel text?
>
> Example: A Tremere with 1 blood can try to recruit a Procurer that cost 2 blood?
>
> I think no since rulebook section 6.2 says you need fulfill all requirements (including costs) when announce the action.
>
He can because the action costs him 1 blood only.

> Sydnelson wrote:
> Another example: A Tremere with 2 blood try to recruit a Procurer that cost 2 blood, in the middle of action they (hope I use new wording correct here) plays an inferior Alacritivy that cost 2 blood but spend only 1 blood in the end due Ankara effect makes the Tremere with 1 blood when action reaches to end. Then when the action it is success since when I declare the action I fulfill costs requirements and Ankara reduce its costs or action fizzle since I don`t have blood to pay for each before use Ankara effect?
>
The recruit action costs him 1 blood. During the action he spends 1 blood to pay the Alacrity, leaving him with 1 blood, which is enough to pay the recruit action.

> Sydnelson wrote:
> When use Charisma or Therboldy Realty and many other cards that increase or reduce costs I also need to have all card cost when I play the card or I can use the effect of those cards before check the payment requirements?
>
The cost reduction is applied immediately, meaning you can play a card that costs originally 2 blood with a vampire with 1 blood.

> Sydnelson wrote:
> The text of Ankara says "you pays only half"
>
Not anymore.

> Sydnelson wrote:
> Example: Enkidu with 1 blood and Charisma can plays a Raptor that cost 2 blood?
>
Yes.

> Sydnelson wrote:
> Example: A player with 1 pool and a Therboldy Realty can plays a Protected Resources? (I know, in this case the player will self-oust but I use it only as an example)
>
Yes.

> Sydnelson wrote:
> Hmmm card text updated.
> Is very hard to track all those card texts changes everytime.
>
